messages:
alex: Quick follow-up on the control-plane / data-plane handshake across hosted, dedicated, and private. We keep getting ad-hoc patches for creds + telemetry when teams onboard private. Can we agree on a small, stable surface to reduce churn?

maya: +1. concrete ask: a 3-call adapter (auth, config-translate, telemetry) so runtime teams only depend on that adapter instead of N bespoke shims.

omar: curious about KMS flows — private wants customer-managed keys, hosted uses redwood KMS. adapter needs to express 'kms-mode' and fallback hints.

alex: exactly. sketch: 1) authorize(token) -> {kind:local|delegated, principals, allowed-scopes}, 2) translate(manifest) -> runtime config (no secrets), 3) emitTelemetry(event) -> best-effort, non-blocking.

lucy: small nit: "non-blocking" telemetry still needs a retry/backpressure contract so we don't OOM in on-prem agents if telemetry endpoint is slow. recommend a bounded queue + drop policy documented.

maya: agree. we should also standardize error codes so control-plane can decide fallback: RETRYABLE_CAPACITY, AUTHZ_DENIED, CONFIG_MISMATCH, INCOMPATIBLE_RUNTIME.

omar: what about network egress rules for private? some customers block control-plane egress but allow telemetry to an internal sink. adapter should support per-field routing hints: e.g., telemetry.sink = [internal-url|redwood-proxy].

alex: good call. propose adapter returns metadata: {requires_controlplane_egress: bool, telemetry_sinks: [string], kms_handoff: boolean}. runtime can then gate flows.

lucy: two operational requests: 1) contract tests (small harness) that control-plane runs on every adapter change; 2) a diagnostics endpoint on adapters to surface last-known decisions for a request-id.

maya: next steps: I'll draft a tiny RFC with interface sketch + sample shim code. if we keep it minimal we can land v1 in 2 weeks.

alex: thanks @maya. one more implementation detail: keep secrets out of translate(manifest) response; provide a secret-reference token that runtime resolves via local KMS integration. Avoid passing plaintext creds.

deploy-bot: CI check: auth-adapter-contract tests failing on staging (request 8321). pinging @omar for logs. :warning:

omar: on it, will triage the CI failure and link findings in the RFC PR.

alex: action items: maya to author RFC + examples, omar to attach CI logs and propose contract test matrix, lucy to write telemetry backpressure guidance. We'll tag infra + runtime for review. :thumbsup:
